rawContent: Look at this kitty chilling out on a box full of my book, Disrupting The Bystander: When #metoo Happens Among Friends!

This powerful thread by @wademullen, who has been tweeting about #MeToo in American Protestant Christianity #ChurchToo, details numerous strategies of evading accountability. Content warning for mention and description of harms.

This thread contains highlights from a discussion moderated by Adrian Daub with the journalists @MoiraDonegan and Evette Dionne @freeblackgirl, which focused on whisper networks and communication in #MeToo 

Content note: brief naming of various harms.

@ferolhumphrey @IBJIYONGI One of the things I ran into most while writing my book about how to respond when #MeToo happens among friends was the belief that being friends meant protecting someone -- even from the consequences of their own actions. I don't agree, and so I'm explicit about it now!

Very cool seeing my book, Disrupting The Bystander: When #metoo Happens Among Friends, sharing a shelf in the Current Events section with @RonanFarrow's Catch And Kill at Books, Inc.! https://t.co/OxEyfz8pio
